name: Kim Ngan Communal House
summary: Walk through the courtyard at 42-44 Hang Bac and into the communal house altar. The ticket is 20,000 VND a visit from 8 December 2025. Day hours are 08:00–12:00 and 13:30–17:30. Friday to Sunday the hall opens again at 19:00 and closes at 21:00 or 21:30. Children under 16 go free. Skip it when the shops on the street are the only stop you want.
heroCaption: The courtyard, tiled hall, and incense urn at Kim Ngan

notice.title: The evening close is 21:00 or 21:30
notice.body: Friday to Sunday the hall opens again at 19:00. Check the board at the gate before you plan to arrive after 21:00.

body: You come in off Hang Bac at numbers 42-44 and walk a brick courtyard to a tiled hall. A tree stands over the court, and an incense urn sits in the middle. The stop is the courtyard and the hall, on the same walk as the shops outside.

From 8 December 2025 the ticket is 20,000 VND a visit. Children under 16 go free, and a child under 1.3 m without papers goes free. Severe disability is free. Students from 16, visitors of 60 and over, people with meritorious service, people on a social concession, solitary older residents, and people from remote mountain areas pay half.

The day runs 08:00–12:00 and 13:30–17:30, every day. Friday, Saturday, and Sunday the hall opens again at 19:00. The evening close is 21:00 or 21:30, so check the board at the gate before a night visit. Entry is also free on 23 November, on the last day of the lunar year, and on the first two days of Tet.

figures.caption: The altar inside Kim Ngan Communal House
figures.alt: The carved wooden altar inside Kim Ngan Communal House, with gilded lions and incense

gettingThere: The communal house is at 42-44 Hang Bac, in the lanes north of Hoan Kiem Lake. Walk north from the lake. Hang Bac is the silver street, and the house sits on it.

legs.heading: From Hoan Kiem Lake
legs.body: On foot, north into the lanes to 42-44 Hang Bac.
